title: Pattern matching — Local Storage Explorer
description: Glob patterns (*.pdf, report-*) filter listings by name. fnmatch semantics cover the everyday cases. Patterns focus exploration fast.
demo:
# Local storage explorer: filter a file listing by pattern, size, and recency.
import fnmatch
files = [{'name': 'a.pdf', 'size': 100, 'mtime': '2024-01-01'}, {'name': 'b.txt', 'size': 50, 'mtime': '2024-01-02'}]
pat, min_size = "*.pdf", 0
print(f"pattern={pat!r} min_size={min_size}:")
for f in files:
    if fnmatch.fnmatch(f["name"], pat) and f["size"] >= min_size:
        print(f"  {f['name']:20} {f['size']:>8} bytes  modified {f['mtime']}")
provenance: Public methodology — standard computer-science technique documented in the technical literature; fact-checked 2026-10-21.
